messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: To make sure tamsulosin is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
an allergy to tamsulosin or any of tamsulosin's ingredients
an allergy to sulfa drugs
kidney problems
liver problems
low blood pressure (hypotension)
Also tell your doctor if you are planning to have cataract or glaucoma surgery.
Ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting tamsulosin and at regular intervals afterwards.
Tamsulosin is not approved for use in women or in children.
Triplet: ["tamsulosin", "has contraindication", "allergy to sulfa drugs"]

The relation 'has contraindication' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'not a substitute for': The subject drug should not be used in place of the medical device or medication specified by the object entity.
C. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
D. 'not used for': The subject drug is not indicated or used for the condition, situation, or purpose specified by the object entity.
E. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
